svg.title: Data flow: how 1391 cues move through seven steps
svg.desc: Flowchart: dog-man-2025's 1391 cues in one column per status; each status connects straight to the step that processes it and passes by the others; every step keeps 1391 cues in total, ending with anchored 1105, verified 6, rescued 21, outlier 86 and interpolated 173.
svg.text: time_cues · matched words → anchored, else none
interpolate_missing · orig + median Δ · outlier keeps label
revert_out_of_order · > 1 s out of order → outlier
finalize_timing · gap 0.084 s · 17 chars/s · 0.8–7 s · ≤0.5 s earlier
